end.summary:
Defined food miles as the distance food travels from where it is grown or made to people.
Linked greater distance with more vehicle travel, fuel use and pollution.
Discussed refrigeration for strawberries and its added fuel, electricity and cost.
Initially confused the eaten place with the food’s source, then corrected this in their later explanation.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised defining food miles and explaining how longer journeys can increase fuel use and pollution. They also discussed why strawberries may need refrigerated transport, adding fuel, electricity and cost. The mix-up between the eating place and the food’s source was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask them to compare two foods and identify where each came from and which travelled farther.
